name: Phase Raider
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, its skin flickering violet and semi-translucent like a bad signal, glowing violet eyes, violet light shimmering off its wing edges, an ember in each claw

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, crouched forward like a pouncer, an ember in each hand
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, flickering in and out like a broken image, violet sparks trailing from its wings

attack.action: flickers violet, then lunges forward and hurls two embers to the right one after the other

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
